articles.title: Bitcoin spikes, then dumps, from $63,700 as analysts assess Strategy's next BTC moves
articles.snippet: BTC, ETH, XRP and others pulled back from their overnight highs as Iran-Israel tensions and oil rally triggered risk aversion in Asian stocks.

articles.title: Bitcoin price $60K support not yet safe as more macro headwinds stack up
articles.snippet: Bitcoin analysis warned that $60,000 may not hold next, as bear-market moves continued and macro hurdles multiplied.

articles.title: Bitcoin risks new purge with bear-market losses still $35B below 2022 total
articles.snippet: Bitcoin realized losses remained below the $211 billion tally from 2022, leading to a prediction that the next bear-market bottom was not yet in.

articles.title: Bitcoin most oversold since 2020 crash: Can BTC rebound to $70K next?
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s latest oversold RSI mirrors 2020 and February 2026 setups that preceded 50% and 30% rebounds, putting $70K back in focus.

articles.title: ETH falls to 13-month low on Zcash bug, Bitcoin below $60K: Is $1.4K next?
articles.snippet: ETH price crashed below $1,600 as a vulnerability in Zcash emerged and Bitcoin sold off below $60,000 for the first time in months.
